tiles: The poster as a piece of design thinking
The pieces I kept for their energy
challenge: Russian Constructivist posters are some of the most alive graphic design ever made — sharp, direct, full of purpose. I wanted to understand why they still feel modern a century later, and see what I could bring back from spending time with them.
approach: I read into the movement, the designers, and the historical moment that produced the work, then drafted many variations trying to capture that directness — strong diagonals, decisive contrast, nothing wasted. I kept the six that felt like they'd absorbed something useful.
result: A set of poster-style pieces I like a lot — confident, a little loud in the best way. They're available as prints for anyone who responds to that design-first energy.
